backtest.disclaimer: DEM+ is scored against next season's published fielding rate. Positional credit and innings are context columns, because DEM+ is the glove per inning, not the value of the position.

frame.basis: FanGraphs' served fielding runs, read verbatim from MLB StatsAPI sabermetrics
frame.components: Statcast range and arm (retroactive to 2016), catcher blocking and throwing, and catcher framing
frame.framing_derivation: rar minus batting, baseRunning, fielding, positional, wLeague and replacement; matches FanGraphs CFraming exactly on the seasons checked
frame.not_ewar: eWAR fielding is Baseball-Reference DRS (fielding_blend_w 0.0), a different frame; it is not on this board
frame.claim: parity with the fWAR fielding frame, framing included; DEM+ is a steadier read of that published series, not a better measure of it

published_fielding.note: Fielding, framing and positional runs are FanGraphs' PUBLISHED values, read verbatim from MLB's bulk season-total feed and joined by MLBAM id. This site computes none of them; DEM+ is the index it computes.

innings.note: Defensive innings by position from MLB's season fielding feed, converted from baseball thirds at ingest.

scale.rate_basis: runs per 1,000 defensive innings (C, 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, LF, CF, RF)
scale.k_source: frozen from the pre-registered fit window, predictor seasons 2016 to 2018 (docs/dem-plus-2026-09-11/DEM_PLUS_GATE.md); LF keeps the positional_fit constant
scale.note: dem_plus_raw = 100 + 10 * (rate_1000_shrunk - pool_mean_rate) / pool_sd_rate. Ten points is one standard deviation of the pool's SHRUNK rates, so this is the WAR/PA+ ruler and not the ratio ruler of HEM+, REM+ and SEM+.

multiyear.note: 3-year DEM+ is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from dem_plus_multiyear_eval.json; it is as of generated_at, not as of this board, and fielders who joined after that date have no value.

team_rollup_framing.note: Team DEM+ and the club run totals roll over non-catchers until the betting program's pre-registered catcher-framing read is recorded; each catcher's own DEM+ still includes his framing.

hem_plus_join.note: HEM+ joined from hitter_leaderboards.json for the glove-versus-bat chart

team_basis.label: fielding 2026
team_basis.note: current_roster points `team` at the club MLB's transaction feed says employs the player today, for the charts AND the aggregates, so an August acquisition credits his whole season to his new club. stats_earned keeps the club the stats were earned with. n_team_unresolved counts rows serving a blank team; those rows are absent from every team rollup.

roster_filter.scope: the constructed alignment ONLY. Team DEM+ and the run totals stay on the full season pool.
roster_filter.on_failure: a failed roster fetch filters nothing
